icons.name: Z-Baleful-Strike
icons.prompt: Edit supplied Veigar Primordial Burst ultimate icon. Keep the single blue-purple magical orb, bright white core, square borderless framing and soft Warcraft III painted style. Make it a little more menacing: deepen the outer sphere to midnight blue and near-black violet, compress the white core into a smaller fiercely burning center, and curve three broad dark violet claw-like energy shadows inward around the core, suggesting violent implosion. These are abstract energy shapes, not literal hands or added objects. Uneven sinister purple halo, restrained blue highlights. Strong dark/light silhouette and heavy ominous power, not a pretty luminous pearl. Keep simple with broad soft blended brushwork readable at 64x64. No face, eyes, skulls, gold hooks, sharp intricate filaments, sparks, debris, text, frame or complex background.

icons.name: V-Primordial-Burst
icons.prompt: Edit this Veigar ultimate spell icon. Make it visually DISTINCT from a blue swirling Z orb. Dominant palette is DARK PURPLE, plum and almost-black violet, virtually no blue or cyan. A menacing compact purple electrical sphere surrounds a substantially LARGER blazing pure WHITE core, occupying roughly one third of the sphere diameter. Three thick irregular white-to-lavender lightning strokes radiate from the core through dark purple masses; keep them angular, NOT spiraling. Strong white center against deep dark purple body, restrained violet outer glow. Preserve simple soft hand-painted Warcraft III icon style, broad shapes readable at 64x64, no tiny lightning branches, sparks, particles, gold, faces, extra objects, text or frame. Quiet smoky dark-purple backdrop. Keep composition focused on a single electrical burst.
